dedupe_keys.name: infraestructura verde santiago web map platform green infrastructure of santiago

description: Infraestructura Verde Santiago is a project, based at the Faculty of Architecture and Urbanism of the University of Chile with a technical committee and adhering institutions, that has prepared a green infrastructure plan for the Santiago metropolitan region. Its web map platform centralises information on green spaces and other elements of green infrastructure to monitor progress, support decisions and encourage citizen participation. The page says the database currently has 27 layers in vector and raster formats, brought together from public, social and private bodies, and it links the platform, an explanatory video and a citizen platform on urban nature in Santiago. Access to the platform is free online; no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: the page describes the platform as under development, the layers and their sources are listed in the platform, not on the page, and the site is in Spanish. Coverage is the Santiago metropolitan region. It supports green infrastructure and climate adaptation planning, such as heat and stormwater management with parks and street trees; related records are the Buenos Aires trees in green spaces and the Sendzimir catalogue of urban nature-based solutions.
